items.followUp: Make a truth table of the OR operator for two variables.

rubric.why: A two-variable truth table must show all four possible input combinations.
rubric.description: Lists all four input combinations for A and B.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for including the four input pairs in the table.

rubric.why: The AND output is 1 only when both inputs are 1.
rubric.description: Gives the correct AND output for each input combination.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for assigning the correct output to all four rows.

items.followUp: Write one disadvantage of mesh topology.

rubric.why: Reliability is a recognised advantage of mesh topology, supported by its dedicated links.
rubric.description: Identifies reliability as an advantage of mesh topology.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying reliability or dedicated links as an advantage.

rubric.why: A failure in one link does not disrupt communication over the other links.
rubric.description: Explains how dedicated links help maintain communication if a link fails.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that a link failure does not affect the other communication paths.

modelAnswer: Mesh topology is highly reliable because devices have dedicated links.
If one link fails, it does not affect communication over the other paths.
